observations.outcome: Placement is accelerated and locked to the chosen direction to reduce gaps and accidental off-line blocks.

observations.title: Extend a build from an air target

observations.outcome: The described placement logic supports extending roofs or flying creative builds without retargeting a solid face each time.
conditions: This is client placement assistance; server validation and available inventory remain authoritative.
